title: Microsoft Edge: security update alerts with a severity threshold in the Edge management service
notes: claim 66: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: The briefing incorrectly says Microsoft Learn never mentions end users: the cited dashboard page describes restart notifications sent to users. The alert behaviour, rollout dates and admin paths are supported; the automation row is a policy instruction rather than a runnable call, and the claim about every managed device is unsubstantiated.
